name: re-oversized-brief

maps_to.criterion: Handoff redesign AC11 and AC3: oversized session-written text passes as UNVALIDATED.
maps_to.risk: A Resumption brief over the hot-file cap validates as UNVALIDATED (exit 0) instead of a size FAIL naming the slot, so the writer copies or cuts it unchecked and the one fact stated only at its end is lost.

description: Source: a reproduced validator result (core sections alone over the cap gave UNVALIDATED, exit 0), rewritten as a synthetic backfill lane. Hard because the newest predecessor's brief is about 26 KB of per-batch status lines and the only statement that warehouse 7 must backfill from 2026-10-01 is its last status line; Remaining actions says only to backfill warehouse 7, so a writer that trims the brief from the end drops the bound and the reader doubles the hand-reconciled rows.

# ledger-backfill

Synthetic service repository for the resume eval.

predecessor.goal: Backfill every warehouse's ledger rows from the legacy system into the new ledger.
predecessor.vision: Finance closes October from the new ledger alone.
predecessor.opening_ask: Backfill all seven warehouses into the new ledger.

injections.text: Every backfill command prints its row count; paste it into the run log before the next warehouse starts.
